TRPAsset.description: Asset admitted by a value or token predicate.

CHAIN_ID.description:
CAIP-2 style chain identifier, e.g. "eip155:1" or
"solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp". Vendor and organization names
are forbidden; a chain is named only by its identifier.

TOKEN_ADDRESS.description: Chain-local token address, or empty for the chain's native asset.

TOKEN_SYMBOL.description: Published token symbol used for display and matching.

DECIMALS.description: Number of decimal places used by the smallest-unit integer balance.

TRPPredicate.description: One independently measurable predicate in a trust rule policy.

PREDICATE_ID.description: Stable identifier unique within the policy.

MIN_VALUE.description: Minimum qualifying value expressed as a uint64 in the smallest unit.

VALUE_CURRENCY.description: Currency or unit used to compare normalized values.

MIN_HELD_SECONDS.description: Minimum continuous holding duration in seconds.

REQUIRED_COUNT.description: X, the number of named trusters that must match.

TRUSTER_IDS.description: The N named `$TRE` trusters considered by a trusted-connections predicate.

MIN_EDGE_WEIGHT.description: Minimum accepted `$TRE.WEIGHT` for a matching trust edge.

TRPGroup.description: Recursive boolean group for a compound trust rule set.

GROUP_ID.description: Stable identifier unique within the policy.

COMBINATOR.description: Boolean operation applied across direct predicates and child groups.

PREDICATES.description: Predicates evaluated directly within this group.

GROUPS.description: Nested groups used to express compound rule sets.

TRP.description: Trust Rule Policy - Signed compound criteria for evaluating one subject.

ROOT.description: Root of the compound rule tree.

EVALUATION_INTERVAL_MS.description:
Periodic evaluation cadence in milliseconds. The 10000 default is the
0.1 Hz baseline and is configurable by the policy author.

EVENT_SOURCES.description:
Event names that may trigger evaluation, e.g. "trust-edge", "trust-node",
"entity-profile", or "chain-balance".

ACTIVE.description: Whether evaluators should currently apply this policy.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this policy was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this policy was last updated.

EVALUATOR_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the evaluator that issued this policy record.

EVALUATOR_SIGNATURE.description: Evaluator signature over the policy record.
